prompt:
TASK: Script Improvement via Failure Log Analysis.

1) READ LOGS: Read '.rokct/agent/logs/requirement_extraction_failures.log' and '.rokct/agent/logs/pdf_extraction_failures.log' in full.
2) ANALYSE: Identify recurring failure patterns across tender IDs. Group by reason. Note which tender IDs appear in both logs.
3) DIAGNOSE: For each pattern, read the relevant script that produced the failure:
   - Failures from requirement_extraction_failures.log → '.rokct/scripts/tenders/enrichment/extract_requirements.py'
   - Failures from pdf_extraction_failures.log → '.rokct/scripts/tenders/enrichment/pdf_to_md.py'
4) PROPOSE FIXES: For each diagnosed pattern, make a targeted, minimal code change to the relevant script. Do not refactor — only fix what the logs prove is broken.
5) CLEAR LOGS: After fixes are committed, truncate both log files to empty (do not delete them).

Goal: Close the loop between script failures and script improvements using real production data. No guessing — every change must trace back to a log entry.
title: Mission: Script Learning from Failures (Monthly)
